purpose: Test whether the binary E/A/U/W gate law predicts continuous interpolation and extrapolation of the grouped MLP6--7 causal response on the fresh-fronted construction.
data_status: FRESH_FRONTED_BINARY_LATTICE_OPEN; CONTINUOUS_BACKGROUND_GAINS_NEW; predictions frozen before any fractional or extrapolated background outcome

binding_evidence.finding: Valid binary background lattice; frozen matched coefficients predict intermediate subsets, with direction shifts -0.10752/+0.09327.
Candidate source construction has a passing 12-cell native capability license.

novelty_audit: Authority searches for MLP6-7 continuous background, context gain, fractional E/A/U/W, and background extrapolation found no prior event.

The prior gain experiment scaled X=MLP6+7 inside a fixed background; this experiment instead scales the E/A/U/W background while measuring X, so it tests the newly identified gate rather than repeating source gain.
map: At the pre-MLP8 raw-state interface define B(r)=B_recipient+r(B_EAUW_donor-B_recipient), holding donor X fixed for the exact arm and absent for the base arm. Let h_X(r)=h_exact(r)-h_base(r). Freeze endpoint laws h_hat_X(r)=h_X(0)+r(h_X(1)-h_X(0)) and q_hat(r)=q(0)+r(q(1)-q(0)), then evaluate new r in {-0.5,0.5,1.5}. Install both exact and predicted head vectors through the unchanged native tail.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_binary_endpoint_cl: All native replay/decomposition/no-op errors are at most 5e-5 and recomputed r=0,1 task effects match the bound binary receipt within 5e-5.
predictions.pred_b_midpoint_head_and_task_prediction: At r=0.5 every opposite-source cell has head-delta cosine at least 0.98, relative error at most 0.15, and predicted-versus-exact task-effect recovery in [0.80,1.20] when |exact margin effect|>=0.01.
predictions.pred_c_extrapolated_head_and_task_predic: At r=-0.5 and 1.5 every opposite-source cell has head-delta cosine at least 0.95, relative error at most 0.30, and live task-effect recovery in [0.70,1.30].
predictions.pred_d_directional_gate_is_manipulable: Mean opposite q(r) decreases monotonically with r for plural-to-singular and increases monotonically for singular-to-plural; r=1.5 has negative plural-to-singular mean and positive singular-to-plural mean.
predictions.pred_e_template_stable: Within each direction and gain, exact q(r) differs between templates by at most 0.04 margin units.
predictions.pred_f_lexical_collateral_absolutely_sma: Maximum absolute exact same-number lexical q(r) is at most 0.02.

null: Failure of b/c means the binary additive profile does not define a continuous gate. Failure of d means the composition law predicts subsets but cannot steer task use continuously. Failure of e localizes template dependence. Failure of f preserves an operational rather than semantic circuit claim. Do not fit a higher-order gain law after opening these gains.
